_note: Khmer consonant -> the Latin letters it is written with in names. Supplied by Vattanac, 20 Sep 2026. Both series collapse to one letter (គ and ក are both K); aspiration collapses again at comparison time, because Cambodian romanisation is not standardised (សុខ is SOK, not SOKH). អ is a vowel carrier and contributes nothing.

nikahit._note: U+17C6 is the M of SAMNANG in សំណាង
